inflow.definition: Reclamation computes inflow from releases and the change in stored water. It also accounts for evaporation and changes in bank storage when those values are included.

release.definition: The daily average total release from Glen Canyon Dam, in cubic feet per second, as published by Reclamation.

6124.name: Lake Mead
6124.inflow_unavailable: Reclamation's Lake Mead catalog has no daily inflow series. River gauges are not used as reservoir inflow.

release.definition: The daily average total release from Hoover Dam, in cubic feet per second, as published by Reclamation.
